jobs.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished art-directed 16:9 full screen high fidelity visual proposal for the Chinese historical narrative game 逆转五丈原. This is a visual proposal only, not an implemented UI. Cinematic photoreal world, restrained dark charcoal, grey-brown paper, thin aged bronze details, small cinnabar primary actions, warm off-white typography. Elegant breathing room and rigorously aligned hierarchy; no oversized empty form, no dashboard, no ornate nested frames, no glowing gold, no thick picture frame around every element. Chinese KaiTi lettering with consistent optical scale: ordinary body and input around 24px at 1440-wide composition, names and section headings 24-26px, controls 20px, supplementary labels 16px minimum; compact hierarchy no giant headings. All typography sharp readable. No explanatory annotations, no mockup title, no device frame or watermarks. PRIMARY SCREEN: Dialogue expands upward into a compact writing overlay. Reference 1 is ONLY the actual underlying dialogue ink-wash edge style and scene language, not the notice character or pole; reference 2 supplies exact Weiyan face, black headwrap, worn armor and dark red fabric. Show Weiyan as photoreal waist-up on right half of a dusk military camp, face fully visible in upper 60% of screen. No spear foreground. Preserve cinematic world across entire screen, no separate writing wallpaper. Top left tiny location "营前传报处"; top right restrained "记录   菜单". The whole interaction occupies ONLY bottom 34% of screen, horizontal 76% width, centered with 12% side margins. Its backing is irregular translucent charcoal ink wash feathering into the scene, not a rigid window. At top of this bottom overlay, a single inline context line: "魏延" followed by "军情有变，我要面见丞相！" with the same clear text scale. Hairline divider. Below it one shallow grey-brown paper writing field about two lines high, no separate giant label or "对魏延说" heading. Input text exactly "将军，先把军情交给我。我替您转呈，不会耽误。" Bottom single action row, left subtle text "润色表达" and "收起", right modest cinnabar button "确认说出". Input and dialogue are equal body scale. Foreground 34%, cinematic character and world 66%. Keep generous field inner padding and unified horizontal alignment. This should feel like extending the existing dialogue, not opening an app.
